Production timeline

How we work

From brief to publication, typically three weeks.

  1. Concept and scriptWithin 3 working days of receiving the final brief.
  2. Your approvalOne round of feedback before we shoot.
  3. ShootOn location in Bangkok, on a date we agree.
  4. Draft deliveredWithin 7 days of the shoot.
  5. RevisionsUp to 2 minor changes, returned within 2 working days.
  6. PublicationOn the agreed date, across all four accounts.
